description.value: BC Liquor Store Richmond Seafair is a provincial government-operated retail outlet selling wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders, part of the 198-store BCLIQUOR chain across British Columbia. The store is located in a strip-mall unit at Seafair in Richmond. It offers a broad product selection and accepts multiple payment methods including cash, debit, Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.
